question: Where is Hoshang Shah’s tomb, the first to be completely built of marble, located in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mandu__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hoshang Shah's tomb is **built by Hoshang Shah Ghori** and is located in **Mandu, Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• It is** one of the oldest marble mausoleums.**
 
• It is corned with a **tiny crescent** which is believed to be **imported from Persia or Mesopotamia.**

**​Hoshang Shah Ghori:**

 
• **Hoshang Shah **(1406-35) is also known as **Alp Khan.**
 
• He was the **first formally appointed Sultan** of the Malwa Sultanate of Central India.
 
• He **moved the capital city** from **Dhar to Mandu.**
 
• On Hoshang’s death in 1435 his son, **Ghazni Khan succeeded** him.
